ui.otherDescription: Ndiri kuda rubatsiro pane chimwe chinhu

mercimek.name: Soup yeLentil
mercimek.description: Soup yeLentil yakagadzirwa kumba nenzira yechinyakare, yakapedzwa nesosi yebhotoro.

tas-kebabi.name: Stew yeNyama yeMombe yeTurkey
tas-kebabi.description: Nyama yemombe, miriwo yemwaka, uye sosi yedu yekubikisa zvishoma nezvishoma resitorendi yedu.

kuzu-tandir.name: Gwayana Rakabikwa Zvishoma
kuzu-tandir.description: Gwayana repamusoro resitorendi yedu, rakabikwa zvishoma nezvishoma pamusoro pemoto wakadzikama.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Rice Pilaf
pirinc-pilavi.description: Rice pilaf yeBaldo ine bhotoro, yakapfava.

firin-sutlac.name: Pudding yeRice Yakabikwa
firin-sutlac.description: Pudding yerayisi yakabikwa nenzira yechinyakare, yakagadzirwa nemukaka webuffalo wemazuva ose.

kuru-fasulye.name: Stew yeBhinzi Chena neNyama Yembudzi
kuru-fasulye.description: Bhinzi dzeİspir, nyama yembudzi yakachekwa, uye paste yetomato isina kusvibiswa yeresitorendi.

izgara-kofte.name: Nyama dzemabhero Dzakagochwa
izgara-kofte.description: Mabhero en nyama yembudzi ayo anogadzirwa semucheka wembudzi pamwe nepepuru rakagochwa uye tomato.

ayran.name: Ayran Yakakanyiwa
ayran.description: Buttermilk yechinyakare yakakanyiwa ine foam yakawanda, inogadzirwa neyogati yokushandisa zuva nezuva.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Soup yeEzogelin
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Soup yechinyakare yeresitorendi panosangana lentils tsvuku, bulgur, nerice pamwe nepeppermint.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Soup yeTarhana
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana yakagadzirwa kumba, chikafu cheAnatolia chinobikwa zvishoma nezvishoma pamwe nematomati uye peppermint yakaoma.

yayla-corbasi.name: Yogati neMupunga Soup
yayla-corbasi.description: Soup inotonhorera uye ine mukaka wakagadzirwa neyogati, mupunga, uye minti yakaoma.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Soup yeTripe
iskembe-corbasi.description: Soup yechokwadi yemombe tripe inopihwa pamwe chete nezvinonhuwira zvayo uye waini yegariki.

dugun-corbasi.name: Wedding Soup
dugun-corbasi.description: Soup yechinyakare yemuchato yakagadzirwa nemhuka yakachekwa uye inonhuhwirirwa nemuto welimon.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Chicken Broth Soup
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: Soup inoporesa yakagadzirwa nemakapena madiki akabikwa mubroth yebhonzo uye nyama yehuku yakachekwa.

domates-corbasi.name: Tomato Soup
domates-corbasi.description: Rimwe bhurawu rakapfuma rakabikwa nematomatisi akakora, bhata, uye basil, rakapedzwa nechingwa cheburi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Soup yemiriwo
sebze-corbasi.description: Soup yakareruka yeparesitauro yakagadzirwa nemiriwo yemwaka, mafuta eolivi, uye miriwo mitsva.

beyran-corbasi.name: Spicy Lamb Beyran Soup
beyran-corbasi.description: Soup yenzvimbo yakagadzirwa pamusoro pemoto wakakwira nemhuru yemakwikwi, mupunga, gariki, uye mhiripiri inopisa.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Soup yemusoro netsoka
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: Soup yakapfuma yemabones yakagadzirwa netsoka dzemombe nemusoro wemhuka zvakabikwa kwemaawa akareba.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Soup yeVermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Soup yemazuva ose yakagadzirwa nehwahwa h huku ine matomatisi, vermicelli, uye parsley.

tavuk-sis.name: Huku Dzenyama Pamhando
tavuk-sis.description: Zvidimbu zvehuku zvakanyikwa nemaspice akakosha, zvinopihwa pamwe chete nemapepuru akagochwa nematomatisi.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk Yegwayana Yakagochwa
kasap-sucuk.description: Nyama yesausage ine zvinonhuwira yakabikwa pamusoro pemarasha, nemiriwo yakagochwa uye hanyanisi nesumac.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill Musanganiswa
karisik-izgara.description: Puranga yakazara uye yakasanganiswa yesarudzo dzemagrill inosanganisira mabhora enyama, huku dzakasungirirwa, mapapu emakwai, nesausage.

nohut-yemegi.name: Stew yeChickpea ne Nyama Yegwayana
nohut-yemegi.description: Chikafu chakagadzirwa pamba chine nyemba uye nyama yehuku yakachekwa zvishoma nezvishoma mubhodhoro rebrass.

patlican-musakka.name: Moussaka yeMatemera
patlican-musakka.description: Matemera akagochwa, nyama yenyama yakapwanyika, uye moussaka yakabikwa muhovheni ine muto wetamatisi, maitiro erezinesi.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Bhinzi Dziri muOiri yeOlive
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: Chikafu chakajairika chakabikwa muoiri yeolive chine bhinzi dzakagadzirwa, matomatisi, nemanyowa, chishumirwa chakatonhorera.

tavuk-sote.name: Huku Yakabikwa muFrying Pan
tavuk-sote.description: Zvidimbu zve huku zvinobikwa pamusoro pekupisa kwakanyanya nemapepuru ane ruvara, ma mushroom, uye matomatisi.

izmir-kofte.name: Maputi eNyama eMazhairi eİzmir
izmir-kofte.description: Chikafu chechinyakare chine mabhora enyama yehuku, mapatatisi, uye mhiripiri yakabikwa mu sosi yematomati.

etli-bezelye.name: Nyemba neNyama
etli-bezelye.description: Chikafu chemazuva ose chinobikwa mupoto chine nyama yaka chekwa, nyemba, karoti, uye mapatatisi.

patlican-oturtma.name: Bhinzi Rakabikwa neNyama Yakachekwa
patlican-oturtma.description: Rurimi runogadzirwa muhovheni nebhinzi, nyama yakachekwa ine munyu wakasviba, uye sosi yatomati ine gariki.

salgam-suyu.name: Juice Yematombo Inotsva
salgam-suyu.description: Juice yechivanhu inopisa yematombo inotsva inotukwa nekaroti yepepuru uye dovi rebhurughu.

maden-suyu.name: Mvura Yezvicherwa
maden-suyu.description: Mvura yezvicherwa chisina chinhu inoiswa inotonhora.

su.name: Mvura yeChisikirwo
su.description: Mvura yechisikirwo inopihwa inotonhorera muhwahwa yegirazi.

gazoz.name: Turkish Lemon Soda
gazoz.description: Soda yechivanhu ine hwema hwakasiyana, inodziya uye inopihwa ichitonhorera.

turk-kahvesi.name: Turkish Coffee
turk-kahvesi.description: Kofi yechivanhu yeTurkey ine foam, inobikwa pakupisa kwakanyanya muCopper cezve.

demleme-cay.name: Turkish Brewed Tea
demleme-cay.description: Tii itsva yakabikwa yeRize inopihwa inopisa mugirazi rakatetepa pahudyu.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Lemonade Yakagadzirwa Pamba
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Lemonade inonwiwa ichigadzirwa zuva rega rega nemalemon matsva, minti, uye shuga shoma.

hosaf.name: Daily Fruit Compote
hosaf.description: Compote yemumba inobikwa zuva rega rega neraisini, maapuro kana plum zvinoenderana nenguva.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: Nyama inotenderedzwa pachikero pamusoro pepide, ichipihwa nesosi yetamati, bhata inopisa, uye yogati.

kazandibi.name: Caramelised Milk Pudding
kazandibi.description: Chikafu chekugadzira mukaka chechinyakare chakakarameliziswa zvakanaka, chine chimiro chakatsetseka.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Ottoman Milk Pudding
tavuk-gogsu.description: Chinwiwa chemukaka chakareruka uye chine fiber chakagadzirwa neimwe nzira yechinyakare, chinopihwa chine sinamoni.

keskul.name: Pudingi reMukaka weAlmond
keskul.description: Chinwiwa chemukaka chemuOttoman chakapedziswa neflavour ye almond uye coconut.

irmik-helvasi.name: Semolina Halva
irmik-helvasi.description: Semolina halva, yakagochwa nebutter uye nzungu dze pine, inopihwa inopisa uye ine mhodzi.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Chinwiwa cheMatango neTahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: Matango, akabikwa zvishoma nezvishoma mumuto waro, anopihwa ne tahini uye walnuts.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Chinwiwa cheQuince
ayva-tatlisi.description: Quince yakabikwa neclove uye sinamoni inopihwa ne clotted cream uye walnuts.

revani.name: Ukapu Hwakasvava hweSemolina
revani.description: Chikafu chinowanzowanikwa maresitorendi uko kapu kasinganyanyi kuoma kwesemolina kusangana nesirasi ine hwema hwelemoni.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudingi yechingwa neKirimu Yakakora
ekmek-kadayifi.description: Pudingi yechingwa inozorodzwa nesirasi yakakangwa inopihwa nekirimu yakakora yebhiza.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava yeKaravhu
cevizli-baklava.description: Mapepa akatetepa zvakanyanya, baklava inonhuhwira uye inopisa yakagadzirwa nezviuru zvekaravhu uye bhotela rakachena.
